headline: Retail accounts bought a net R$ 1.35 bn on a R$ 28.8 bn session while institutional, mixed and HFT desks sold, with foreign flow effectively flat.
Several of the day's largest turnovers, BBDC4 and PETR3 among them, are blocks and crosses between houses rather than directional flow.
OBTC3 carries a seven-session broker streak on the sell side, a pattern the radar has been flagging on consecutive days rather than one that opened today.
